comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber vs feed a press blank under a minimally raised guard.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-tool fastening, collar tuning, and guarded test actuation vs one-hand guard support and push-stick feeding with hands outside the hazard.
comparison.success_condition: Two non-bottoming, force-bounded impacts with no drift vs blank at the back stop, stick withdrawn, guard never above 8 cm and lowered safely.
comparison.reason: Shared machinery safety sequencing is generic; press feeding tests guarded insertion and coordinated support, not component commissioning.
